Definition: from G2857; a Colossæan, (i.e. inhabitant of Colossæ:--Colossian.
BiblicalUsage: Kolossaeus is a Colossian, an inhabitant of Colosse, but the word never actually occurs in the Greek text: no verse uses it, and no form of it stands anywhere in the Scriptures.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that honesty matters more than filling a gap: where the text is silent, I say so, and I will not invent a verse for a word the apostles never wrote.
